description: A finite family of pairwise coprime nonzero natural moduli admits a simultaneous solution to every prescribed family of remainder congruences.
signature:
Nat.chineseRemainderOfFinset.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} (a s : ι → ℕ) (t : Finset ι) (hs : ∀ i ∈ t, s i ≠ 0)
  (pp : (↑t).Pairwise (Function.onFun Nat.Coprime s)) : { k // ∀ i ∈ t, k ≡ a i [MOD s i] }
